product_metadata.title: NeverCurl 4pk Rug Corner Grippers - Instantly Flattens Rug Corners Stops Slipping, Stiff Layer Prevent Curling, Renewable Carpet Gripper Sticky Gel, Easy Lift Design to Clean Under Rugs, Carpet Tape
features: PREMIUM FEATURES - This rug corner gripper set includes four (4) V-shape corner pieces that instantly flatten curled rug corners and grip the floor to stop rug from slipping and sliding. The renewable sticky gel bottom of NeverCurl grips the floor! The top side of NeverCurl adheres to the rug.

NEW EVA FOAM TIP UPDATE - The new EVA foam tip update allows easy rug lifting so you can quickly pull up the corner. Our old design made it difficult to pull start and lift the corner. Renewable sticky gel bottom of NeverCurl grips the floor! No more rug slip or rug sliding; the top side of NeverCurl adheres to the rug. After numerous re-applications, only the rug side adhesive on NeverCurl may need refreshing by applying "Mighty X" double-sided carpet tape.

BEST SHAPE & SIZE - The V-shape design will not twist and turn like the straight ones. These rug corner grippers work on all indoor rugs in the kitchen, hallways, bathrooms, and hardwood floors in any thickness and size. These can be used outdoors to flatten corners only. Works great with Roombas. If you use over rug pads, you may need to cut out the area on the rug pad (L shape) below the NeverCurl.

RENEW THE STICKY GEL BOTTOM - Simply wipe down with a damp cloth to renew tackiness. Wipe the floor and white gel with rubbing alcohol to really increase stickiness. It will not harm the floors as the stick gel is "oil-free" unlike many rug tapes and rug pads that harm floors over time. This works best over wood, tile, laminate, and hard floorings. Not recommended for use over carpets.

REGISTERED USA-BASED BRAND & TRUSTED QUALITY PRODUCTS - We are a USA-based home products brand trusted and reviewed by thousands of satisfied happy customers. We develop and design the products by listening to your needs and concerns. We always take care of customers' queries and go beyond to make you happy with our customer service.
